brief.objective: A French fashion house founded in Paris in 1854 as a trunk maker. Its collections include luggage, handbags, clothing, shoes and accessories.

creativeThesis: One Monogram trunk travels from a steam-filled Paris platform, across a liner's deck, to a sunlit station today.

intent.product: Louis Vuitton Monogram canvas trunk, with the Keepall as the present-day travel piece
intent.audience: Luxury travel and fashion buyers on vertical social
intent.message: Louis Vuitton has been made for travel since it began as a Paris trunk maker in 1854.

realWorldGrounding: Brief fact: founded in Paris in 1854 as a trunk maker
Real products: Monogram canvas trunk with wooden slats and brass corners; Monogram Keepall (brand product photo)
Brand travel films A Holiday Journey and Le Keepall: The Legend (ref-1, ref-2)

selectedGoal.title: The Trunk's Long Journey
selectedGoal.description: Heritage travel story in three wide, moving stations: the trunk departs, crosses the sea, and arrives in the present beside a Keepall. The 1854 trunk-maker origin is told through journeys, not claims.
selectedGoal.style: Steam grey, slate blue and cream daylight; soft period haze in early scenes to crisp present-day light; 35mm and 24mm lenses, wide frames, gentle film grain

styleTags.openingAction: trunk lowered onto a station luggage cart
styleTags.pacing: three 5s wide travelling takes, cross-era hard cuts
styleTags.cameraLanguage: lateral dolly, tracking along deck, slow push-in

decisionEvidence.selectedReason: Uses the brief's own 1854 Paris trunk-maker fact and real luggage products as a travel story.

referencesUsed.title: A Holiday Journey | LOUIS VUITTON
referencesUsed.why: The brand's own journey-led film: travel as the narrative spine, wide moving shots, product carried through places. Transferable: one continuous journey told in stations. Metrics not verified in time (null).

referencesUsed.title: Le Keepall: The Legend | LOUIS VUITTON
referencesUsed.why: Heritage-object storytelling: one real product (the Keepall) framed as a travel icon across eras. Transferable: period-to-present arc anchored on a single real piece. Metrics not verified in time (null).

creative.reason: A clear three-station heritage travel arc (steam platform, liner deck, modern station) with real Monogram pieces centred in every frame. Opening action is gentle rather than a hard physical hook.
creative.biggestProblem: Hook in the first second is soft.

slopHits.note: bag already on cart; lowering motion is subtle
